name: Asset Editor
intro: The Asset Editor is where you place, style and save the text on a campaign creative. It puts your headline, body and call to action over the picture.

features.canvas: The canvas shows your asset in its platform's shape, with live text over the picture. Click any text block to select it and see a dashed outline.
features.headline-body-and-cta-tabs: The Headline, Body and CTA tabs choose which block you're editing. Clicking a block on the canvas does the same, so you can style each one separately.
features.text: The Text box holds the words of the selected block, and the canvas updates as you type. Use it to reword the AI copy or fix a typo.
features.position: Position gives you nine spots on a three by three grid. Choose one to place the block where your picture has empty space.
features.size: Size offers small, medium, large and huge. Use it to set the hierarchy, so the headline stands out and the body stays supportive.
features.color: Color sets the text color. You get swatches for white, black and your brand colors, plus a picker and a box for a hex code.
features.background: Background puts a color behind the text. It helps text stand out on a busy picture, or gives your call to action a button shape.
features.font: The Font list shows your brand fonts first, then clean fallbacks. Each option previews in its own typeface so you can choose at a glance.
features.save: Save stores your text, picture and layout with the asset. There's no undo, so save often to keep your edits.

outro: That's the Asset Editor. Style each block, save your work, and your creative is ready for the campaign.
